hook: He lives in Katy. I live in Montrose. We tried.
caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. He lives in Katy. I live in Montrose. We tried: halfway on a feeder road, the Westheimer bumps, a Texas U-turn the wrong way, a coffee shop that was closed. Same place, same night, finally. Where are you driving in from?
